# Phase Two — File Map And Twenty Improvements

## First files/systems to inspect before any rewrite
- Current release/test job output and generated sitemap/catalog counts.
- Current git dirty tree and overlap map.
- Production-faithful validator and Chrome target state.
- `shared/commerce/*` global event/launcher/Radiance modules.
- `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/server/*` startup lifecycle and database initialization.
- Existing recents/favorites/history/resume modules across Apps/Games/global shell.
- Existing workflow/share/export/import/open-with modules.
- Wallet reservation/reconciliation/audit modules and tests.

## Twenty improvements over the previous wave
1. Close the current release gate before stacking unrelated writes on top.
2. Distinguish generated discovery records from unique canonical URLs everywhere.
3. Treat catalog descriptions as canonical normalized fields, not legacy aliases.
4. Verify generated-source freshness after every catalog-source change.
5. Make browser proof production-faithful rather than raw-static.
6. Verify mobile layout at a real 390px viewport.
7. Verify keyboard/focus behavior on the global commerce launcher and sheet.
8. Verify reduced-motion/high-contrast CSS remains functional.
9. Time full server startup with the newly added stage timers.
10. Do not reorder database/auth initialization without measured evidence.
11. Preserve privacy-minimal telemetry as local integration events until a proven sink exists.
12. Never add analytics payload fields by convenience; keep explicit allowlists.
13. Prefer existing persistence infrastructure for recents/favorites/resume.
14. Prefer linkable route-state handoffs over opaque cross-app state when possible.
15. Keep paid value server-authoritative and fulfillment-backed.
16. Keep games non-pay-to-win and cosmetic/convenience/value oriented.
17. Add reconciliation visibility before increasing economic complexity.
18. Add tests beside every shared/global feature because blast radius is platform-wide.
19. Re-read touched files fully after writes and write planned-vs-actual deltas.
20. Leave explicit continuation breadcrumbs for any unfinished dependency.
